title: Sulzer API 610 Heavy Duty Centrifugal Pump Manual - P-101A/B
text: Section 4.3 Vibration Anomalies: Vibration exceeding 4.5 mm/s RMS on bearing housing indicates mechanical unbalance, misalignment, or bearing degradation. The equipment manual lists bearing wear and insufficient radial clearance as primary causes for severe high-frequency vibration spikes above baseline.

title: Sulzer API 610 Heavy Duty Centrifugal Pump Manual - P-101A/B
text: Section 5.8 Motor and Bearing Temperature Limits: Normal operating bearing temperature is 65 deg C to 80 deg C. If motor or bearing temperature reaches 110 deg C, a High Alarm (HA) is triggered. If temperature reaches or exceeds 130 deg C, a High-High Alarm (HHA) trips the unit and immediate bearing inspection and lubrication replenishment is required.

title: MRPL Preventive Maintenance Schedule Log - CDU-1
text: Maintenance Log Entry: Crude Charge Pump P-101 drive-end bearing inspection is 45 days overdue. Lube oil analysis indicated minor particulate contamination during previous quarterly audit. Operator recommended vibration survey before next turnaround.

title: Mechanical Seal Flushing and Leak Detection SOP - Booster Pumps
text: Standard Operating Procedure: Plan 53A dual mechanical seal for P-204 must maintain barrier fluid pressure 1.5 bar above seal chamber pressure. Any fluid drop in reservoir indicates inner seal compromise. Zero visible leakage from gland packing is required during steady-state operation.

title: Booster Pump P-204 Turnaround Inspection Report
text: Maintenance Inspection Log: P-204 mechanical seal assembly inspected and passed static/dynamic nitrogen pressure test at 6.0 bar with zero leakage detected. Shaft runout measured 0.02 mm, well within API tolerance. Healthy condition confirmed.

title: Elliott Multi-Stage Wet Gas Centrifugal Compressor Manual - K-101
text: Anti-Surge and Vibration Protection: Maximum allowable vibration during normal loaded operation is 2.8 mm/s. Anti-surge bypass valve must open rapidly when flow approaches surge line (minimum safe suction flow 14,500 Nm3/h). Compressor surge causes rapid thrust bearing reversal and severe shaft displacement.

title: Refinery DCS Alarm and Actuator Specifications - Utilities
text: Pneumatic Control Valve V-402: Normal position is 15% throttling. If bypass valve V-402 is stuck open or exhibits positioner hunting greater than 5% travel deviation, verify air supply pressure (min 4.2 bar) and stroke test positioner feedback linkage.

title: Crude Distillation Column C-101 Differential Pressure Incident Analysis
text: Incident Root Cause Report: High differential pressure (> 0.45 bar) across trays 14-22 of column C-101 was caused by heavy oil foaming and tray weeping under reduced reflux. Operator intervention required reducing feed preheat by 8 deg C to stabilize column hydraulics.

title: Refinery-wide Rotating Equipment Lubrication Management SOP
text: Turbine and Pump Lubrication Standard: ISO VG 46/68 synthetic hydrocarbon oil required for all API 610 pumps. Moisture content must remain below 100 ppm. High bearing vibration is frequently correlated with degraded oil viscosity or particle counts exceeding ISO 18/16/13.
